name: proxy
displayName: Proxy Smart — SMART on FHIR administration
description: Administer YOUR SMART on FHIR authorization proxy from the conversation. Bundles the smart-app-onboarding and smart-launch-debugging skills + the deployment's own MCP server, whose tools are generated from the admin API: register and configure SMART apps, manage scopes and scope sets, healthcare users and practitioner roles, FHIR servers, identity providers, and Keycloak Organizations. Proxy Smart is self-hosted, so set PROXY_SMART_URL to your instance before installing. To try Proxy Smart without deploying one, install proxy-beta instead.
